_comment: Lesson 3.2 (part 3) — how VS Code Cline is told about a server.
Copy this into the Cline MCP settings file (Cline -> MCP Servers -> Configure).
The `command` + `args` pair is the stdio transport: Cline runs this program and speaks
JSON-RPC over its stdin/stdout. Nothing listens on a port.
`disabled: false` and an explicit `autoApprove` list are deliberate: a tool that is not
named there still prompts the human. Do NOT copy a wildcard autoApprove into a real
deployment — approving every tool automatically removes the review step that M10 is about.

course-hardened._comment: The M10 server: read-only tools over an allowlisted directory.
